item.title: Blood moon watch: Will the total lunar eclipse be visible in Connecticut?
item.description: NEW HAVEN, Conn. (WTNH) — The first- and only- total lunar eclipse of the year will light the moon blood red Tuesday morning. item.title: War widens as Trump says Iran strikes could last several weeks
item.description: With no sign of the conflict abating anytime soon, the president said operations are likely to last four to five weeks but that he was prepared “to go far longer than that.”

item.title: Future looks promising for cancer-detecting blood tests
item.description: Some of the most dangerous cancers are the types that are hard to detect. As a result, they are often caught too late to treat. Some emerging technologies could change that in the future, with simple blood tests that detect cancer.

item.title: Military equipment used in strikes against Iran relying on Connecticut manufacturing
item.description: The US and Israel's recent strikes on Iranian targets included weapons components built, designed or supported by Connecticut firms, including the F-35 stealth fighter jet powered by a Pratt & Whitney engine, the C-17 Globemaster cargo aircraft, the KC-46 Pegasus refueling tanker, and Tomahawk cruise missiles.
